mapper.sql: o.*, s.name AS store_name, s.platform, w.name AS warehouse_name, ch.name AS channel_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ecom_order_item oi WHERE oi.order_id = o.id) AS item_count
FROM ecom_order o JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = o.store_id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = o.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN ecom_logistics_channel ch ON ch.id = o.channel_id
